        Rectangle(plate_length, plate_width)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    (-plate_length/2 + mount_hole_offset_x, -plate_width/2 + mount_hole_offset_y),

    (plate_width/2 - mount_hole_offset, -plate_height/2 + mount_hole_offset),
    (plate_width/2 - mount_hole_offset, plate_height/2 - mount_hole_offset),

]

    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, y, 0) * Cylinder(mount_hole_dia/2, plate_thickness + 1)

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, -plate_thickness/2 + central_cbore_depth/2) * Cylinder(central_cbore_radius, central_cbore_depth)
